messages:
sarah (ops): Heads-up: new on-prem offline-image import policy and signed-package flow is going live for Private customers next Tue 2026-07-07. This is aimed at air-gapped customers who can't pull images from our registry. Details + runbook: https://go/internal/offline-image-policy-2026 (internal).
omar (eng-release): TL;DR: we now provide a signed tarball (.redpkg) that customers can import via the CLI or a USB. The package is signed with our release key and includes a SHA256 manifest + provenance.json. Example verify command: \n```\n# verify package signature\nredwood pkg verify my-release-20260707.redpkg --pubkey /etc/redwood/release_pub.pem\n```\nIf verification fails, agent refuses install.
toni (security): Important: for air-gapped imports we require an "import approval token" generated by the customer admin and committed to the readiness sheet. Support will not accept unsigned bundles. The token ties the import to an account and an expiry window.
ben (support): We'll add columns: offline_import_token, image_checksum_verified, importer_contact. Also prepping canned instructions for customers doing USB import.
mira (sales): Any contractual impact for customers requesting offline images? We need to add a CL clause?
frank (legal): Legal note: we'll require customers to sign the Offline Image Addendum that limits redistribution and mandates proof of chain-of-custody. Small addendum, no price change. I'll upload the template by EOD and add a fast-track for existing enterprise customers.
opsbot: release-scheduler: Draft rollout created for offline-image-policy wave-1: start=3371300000 window=14400 owner=@sarah id=offline-33713 :package:
sarah (ops): Maintenance notes: import should be scheduled during low-traffic windows. Offline import is an asynchronous operation and may pause inference for up to 10 minutes while images are validated and expanded. We'll document expected downtime in the customer-facing checklist.
omar (eng-release): Customer CLI import example (USB or local host): \n```\n# local import\nredwood pkg import /mnt/usb/my-release-20260707.redpkg --customer CUST-ACME \
  --approval-token abcd-ef01 --verify\n# remote (support-assisted) we require signed consent in ticket metadata\n```\nNote: agent will create backup snapshot before applying. Rollback command: `redwood pkg rollback --snapshot SNAPID`.
toni (security): For support-assisted imports, customer must include a signed consent string in the ticket. Support will escalate to Security for any third-party media usage. We'll record hash of imported media and include it in the audit log.
ben (support): We'll surface the import status in the Support UI and include a step to paste the package SHA256 for verification. If checksum mismatch, we refuse to proceed.
mira (sales): We'll prepare a short FAQ for customers who ask why we don't just push updates in air-gapped envs.
sarah (ops): Action items: Legal - upload addendum (@frank); Support - add three readiness columns and checklist (@ben); Eng-release - add verify commands to runbook and ensure rollback snapshot is automatic (@omar); Security - publish import token flow and consent requirements (@toni). React with :white_check_mark: when done. We'll hold GA if any of these pieces are missing by Mon 23:59 UTC. Thanks!
